test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Given below are three statements and three conclusions. Take the statements to be true even if they are at variance with commonly known facts, and decide whether the conclusion/s follow/s the given statements.

Statements:

I. All pen drives are hard drives.

II. Some hard drives are chips.

III. All chips are keyboards.

Conclusions:

I. Some keyboards are pen drives.

II. Some chips are pen drives.

III. Some keyboards are hard drives.
solution:
**Given:**

Statements:

I. All pen drives are hard drives.

II. Some hard drives are chips.

III. All chips are keyboards.

**Concept used:**

These statements can be expressed as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1ac5cb80a7d75eba6a03747545cc193d22824115cdb1b29caafaa0626c15c58.png] 

**Solution:**

Conclusions:

I. Some keyboards are pen drives.**: False- **No part of keyboards is contained in pen drives.

II. Some chips are pen drives. **False:- **No part of chips are contained in pen drives.

III. Some keyboards are hard drives. **True- **Some portion is contained in hard drives.

**Thus the correct answer is 'Only conclusion III follows' .**
